text:
alex: Heads-up — we're rolling the EU dedicated change in the 23:00 UTC change window. Target: model-service pin from v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0. Canary 5% for 10m, then ramp. I've updated release notes and linked runbooks. Deploybot will run preflight at t-5.

deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT CHECKS: configs verified, infra health OK, canary route set, alerting hooks attached. responding: /deploy start in 300s. (automated)

maria: Quick Q — what are exact rollback thresholds? p95 latency + error rate thresholds?

kai: Rollback if p95 > 250ms over 5m OR sustained error rate > 0.5% for 3m. Also unpin if canary causes quality regressions > eval threshold. See runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/deploy-backout (ops-runbook v2)

sre-oncall: Add note: emergency kill-switch is `deploybot abort`. That will drain new canary traffic and pin previous version automatically. Keep creds handy.

alex: Copy. Plan: start canary. Maria you'll own watch. Kai do routing rollback. I'll handle release notes + comms.

deploybot: CANARY STARTED: 5% traffic -> v3.3.0. canary_id=cb-2026-03-20-01

maria: Seeing slight p95 bump to 210ms — keeping an eye :eyes:

deploybot: CANARY UPDATE: 5m into canary. p95=240ms, errors=0.12%. Threshold on p95 is 250ms.

maria: p95 trending up to 260ms over 1m, errors 0.35% — holding canary. :warning:

alex: HOLD. rollback plan ready?

kai: Ready. Runbook excerpt:
- abort canary: `deploybot abort cb-2026-03-20-01 --reason="p95 spike"`
- pin old version: `curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/api/pin -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"model-service","version":"v3.2.1"}'`
- drain new tasks: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/model-service --to-revision=stable`

alex: Execute when ready. Maria confirm observed metrics for 3m window.

maria: Confirmed — 3m sustained p95 > 250ms and error rate trending toward 0.6%. executing abort now.

deploybot: ABORTING canary cb-2026-03-20-01. Draining canary traffic. Starting pin to v3.2.1. ETA ~60s.

deploybot: PIN SUCCESS: model-service pinned to v3.2.1. Canary cb-2026-03-20-01 terminated. Notifying pager, updating release status.

sre-oncall: Monitoring infra, no increased 502s. Attaching post-abort checklist to incident: https://internal.redwood/incidents/3187650000

alex: Thanks team. Minimal user impact, small latency ripple. Documenting in release notes + changelog. We'll run a lightweight postmortem tomorrow.

maria: I'll add confirm tests and add small evals to catch this class of regression before the next push. :thumbsup:

alex: Closing thread. Thanks all. :shipit:
